offers_products.reason: Sells insurance brokerage, risk management and benefits advice; no manufactured goods or software as main offering.

offers_services.reason: Insurance brokerage, risk management consulting, employee benefits and claims consulting are its core services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Offers personal insurance coverage for individuals and families, though a smaller part than commercial business.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main clients are businesses, real estate owners, healthcare and dealerships buying commercial insurance and employee benefits.

recurring_revenue.reason: Commissions and fees come from annually renewing insurance policies and ongoing benefits programs.

cyclical_demand.reason: Insurance coverage is largely mandatory or essential and renewed annually, so demand holds in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Annual policy premiums and renewals are recurring, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value is brokers' expertise placing coverage, advising and claims consulting; revenue is commissions and fees for staff work.

large_customers.reason: Serves a broad middle market of businesses, individuals and families, not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Insurance brokerage is asset-light, relying on offices and people; growth comes through acquiring brokerages.

notes: Customer size is mixed (middle market to multinationals plus individuals), so large_customers is a judgement call.
